notes.title: THE GAME IS ON!
notes.content:
| Follow the journey of two girls unraveling Limbo, Purgatory and Hell, while dealing with the various souls along the way and all the mysteries of the Alchemist who forged this place: Nicolau Flamel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43878437/cf1b7315f6998026ac82d38648604f5bb358015d.png[/img]

| Coralina is an independent game, focused on narrative, retro graphics and many different art styles to catch your eyes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43878437/3bab4ff4abfec7976cba3e46595ae7665eb5690e.png[/img]


Take advantage of the launch promo! 

 “In an unexpected adventure, Coralina found herself thrown into a playful and confusing world after a mysterious event....”

notes.title: CORALINA: A MEMORY TALE (RELEASE DATE)
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the release date for [b]Coralina: a Memory Tale[/b]! Mark the date: [b]September 13th 2024[/b], get ready for a Friday The 13th full of unreveals...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43878437/cb7e205a5bf613652b3925a2e1a3310d61478727.jpg[/img]

(on the image:[i] 3 days left![/i])

notes.title: DEMO AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce Coralina Chapter 2!

"Coralina: a Memory Tale" is the sequel to Cora's story, and the game has a free demo now available to play! We hope you like it and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43878437/81cfc37fc5192e1bb385885de098725af98d41a3.png[/img]
